QuestInfo.name: OSSS Mission 4: Retrieving Alien Chips and Spy Cameras
QuestInfo.1: The aliens have planted Spy Chips and Spy Cameras inside monsters in Maple World. Retrieve 30 of each so that the aliens can no longer monitor Maple World. You have a chance to obtain Spy Chips and Spy Cameras whenever you defeat monsters in Maple World.
QuestInfo.2: Receive this mission again after completing the other missions.

0.0: You've been issued a special mission from the OSSS. You can complete it if you have the #b#t4032717##k.

yes.0: I see that you have the #b#t4032717##k. I will issue you Mission 4.
yes.1: We received a report that aliens have placed spy chips and cameras inside monsters to collect information about Maple World. We cannot let this be!
yes.2: Please retrieve #b30 spy cameras and 30 spy chips#k from the monsters in Maple World.
yes.3: You will get a medal when you complete the mission. Talk to #b#p9250135##k to upgrade your suit using those medals.

no.0: Idle chat can wait until after you've saved Maple World...

yes.0: Thank you for your work. Here is your medal. Head over to #b#p9250135##k to purchase various cells that can be used to upgrade your suit.
yes.1: And as for the #b#t4032721##k, submit it with the other ones once all four missions have been completed.

default.0: Looks like you haven't finished the mission just yet...
